snippet.title: Spirit Crossing | Official Game Announcement | Netflix
snippet.description:
Journey to a land between worlds in Spirit Crossing: a cooperative village life sim designed to foster friendship, kindness, and community.

Find out more and sign up for early access at: http://playspiritcrossing.com

About Netflix:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

Spirit Crossing | Official Game Announcement | Netflix
https://www.youtube.com/@Netflix

Escape beyond the ordinary to a place where humans and spirits work together. Build a place to call your own with your friends in Spirit Crossing.
